# Belinda

## Overview

- **Age:** Fourteen years old during her time serving at Echo Cottage before moving to Boston  <sub>[v2 c21 P76](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0076)</sub>
- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v2 c21 P76](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0076), [v3 c23 P7](../source/v03-c23.md#nw-v03-c23-p0007)</sub>
- **Origin:** St. Brendan’s Island  <sub>[v3 c23 P10](../source/v03-c23.md#nw-v03-c23-p0010)</sub>
- **Role:** Handmaiden and domestic helper  <sub>[v2 c21 P76](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0076), [v2 c28 P56](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0056)</sub>
- **Nicknames:** Belinda the Fourth  <sub>[v2 c21 P61](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0061), [v2 c21 P76](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0076)</sub>; Leonora  <sub>[v2 c21 P76](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0076)</sub>

## Appearance

Belinda has freckles on her face, a snub nose, and an exceptionally broad mouth and smile. In her early teens, she was known for wearing bright blue ribbon bows in her hair. As she grew into a mature young woman, she stopped wearing her blue bows and adopted a massive pompadour hairstyle.

_Sources: [v2 c23 P3](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0003), [v2 c28 P48](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0048), [v2 c30 P11](../source/v02-c30.md#nw-v02-c30-p0011), [v3 c23 P7](../source/v03-c23.md#nw-v03-c23-p0007)_

## Personality

Belinda is an energetic, joyful, and deeply devoted domestic servant who holds immense affection for her mistress. She is extraordinarily obedient, willing to carry out whatever tasks or imaginative requests her mistress asks without complaint or judgment. She possesses a lively and spirited nature, though she can feel indignant when excluded from secrets by those she considers close friends.

_Sources: [v2 c21 P61](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0061), [v2 c21 P73](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0073), [v2 c21 P76](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0076), [v2 c23 P3](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0003), [v2 c28 P18](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0018), [v2 c28 P48](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0048), [v2 c28 P56](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0056), [v2 c30 P11](../source/v02-c30.md#nw-v02-c30-p0011)_

## History

Belinda came to reside at Echo Cottage as a handmaiden for Miss Rosalind Penrose, following her three older sisters who had previously served there. Because of her physical resemblance to her eldest sister, Miss Rosalind routinely addressed her as 'Belinda the Fourth'. During her time at Echo Cottage, she assisted in domestic tasks, shared late-night snacks with Miss Rosalind, and helped prepare for local visitors. She formed a warm friendship with Nell Harcourt and Isolde, welcoming them eagerly whenever they visited the stone cottage. Prior to Miss Rosalind's wedding, Belinda helped prepare the house amidst bustling activity. After the wedding, she moved to Boston with Miss Rosalind and Mr. Stanhope, where she suffered from extreme homesickness. In subsequent summers, she returned to Echo Cottage for July and August as a mature young woman, maintaining her deep affection and devotion to her household and friends.

_Sources: [v2 c21 P61](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0061), [v2 c21 P76](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0076), [v2 c23 P3](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0003), [v2 c27 P29](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0029), [v2 c28 P18](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0018), [v2 c28 P48](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0048), [v2 c30 P3](../source/v02-c30.md#nw-v02-c30-p0003), [v2 c30 P11](../source/v02-c30.md#nw-v02-c30-p0011), [v3 c7 P48](../source/v03-c07.md#nw-v03-c07-p0048), [v3 c23 P1](../source/v03-c23.md#nw-v03-c23-p0001), [v3 c23 P7](../source/v03-c23.md#nw-v03-c23-p0007), [v3 c40 P0](../source/v03-c40.md#nw-v03-c40-p0000)_

## Background by volume

- Her actual given name is likely Leonora Bowman  <sub>[v2 c21 P76](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0076)</sub>
- She is the youngest of the Bowman sisters  <sub>[v2 c21 P76](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0076)</sub>
- Arranged to live at Echo Cottage in exchange for room, board, and garments  <sub>[v2 c21 P76](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0076)</sub>
- Succeeded her older sisters Belinda, Julietta, and Evelina in serving Miss Rosalind  <sub>[v2 c21 P76](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0076)</sub>
